text:
alice_p: Quick UX check — noticed a couple things in the compliance modal after the latest build. Retention toast ordering feels odd and KMS labels are confusing for non-security folks. Can we sync?

ben_d: Yep saw that. The toast shows 'Retention saved' then the region selector changes below it, which looks like the save didn't apply to region. Feels like visual drift.

clara_f: Screenshot? I can repro — sequence is: update retention -> modal closes -> toast appears -> region dropdown resets to default because of state rehydrate.

alice_p: Exactly. Users might assume retention was saved for the wrong region. Suggestion: show toast anchored to the modal until state settle, or include region name in toast like 'Retention (us-west) saved'.

ben_d: +1 to including region in toast. Also the KMS label in the audit log reads 'Encrypted: customer' which is terse and ambiguous. A teammate asked if that means customer-managed key or customer data.

diego_s: That's on us — backend currently stores "encrypted: customer" vs "encrypted: platform". We can change payload to include `kms_owner: customer|platform` but will need small API bump for audit event shape.

eli_a: Accessibility nit: the toast disappears in 3s; with longer copy (region + retention) it's not readable for keyboard-only or screen reader users. We should ensure it is focusable and announced via ARIA live.

clara_f: Implementation plan: (1) update toast text to include region, (2) extend duration to 8s for longer messages and add `role="status" aria-live="polite"`, (3) ensure toast anchor stays if modal triggered save sequence. I can do a PR for 1+2. For the API change Diego mentions, will coordinate.

ben_d: For the KMS label copy, propose changing audit log entry from `Encrypted: customer` to `Encrypted with customer-managed key (KMS)` or shorter `Customer-managed KMS`. Both give clearer signal. Thoughts?

diego_s: Prefer `Customer-managed KMS` — concise and matches security docs. Backend will send `kms_type: customer_managed` and front-end renders human text. We'll add field but keep backward compat by reading old `encrypted` boolean if new field missing.

alice_p: That sounds good. Also, small copy tweak for retention modal: current help text says "Choose retention window" — unclear if it's per-region. Suggest: "Retention window for selected region".

eli_a: +1. And add aria-describedby linking help text to the radio group so assistive tech reads context. Also contrast for the KMS badge is low on hover, need +15% contrast.

clara_f: I'll update the copy and aria attributes in the same PR. Ben — can you propose exact strings for designer review?

ben_d: Sure — mock strings: toast -> `Saved retention — us-west (30 days)`. KMS badge -> `Customer-managed KMS` with tooltip: `Your data is encrypted with a key you control.` Modal help -> `Retention window for selected region. Limits how long generated data is stored.`

alice_p: Love it. Diego, ETA on adding `kms_type` field?

diego_s: I can add it to the audit payload today, patching the event schema. Will deploy by EOD, tests included. Backfill not required.

clara_f: Great — I'll start PR after Diego's deploy so FE can read new field. Will include aria-live, focus handling, and extend toast duration.

eli_a: I'll do a quick axe pass on the branch when it's up — will flag any contrast/token issues.

alice_p: Action items: Diego (add kms_type + deploy), Clara (PR for toast + copy + ARIA), Ben (final copy review), Eli (a11y pass). I'll follow up on QA. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: audit-service v2.3.1 -> production at 18:45 UTC (diego_s).
